title: XPeng IRON Humanoid Robot Planned for Q2 2027 Launch, Hardware Mass Production to Start in January
excerpt: He Xiaopeng, Chairman and CEO of XPeng Motors, announced at XPeng Tech Day 2026 that the humanoid robot XPeng IRON will enter the hardware mass-production phase
content_html:
He Xiaopeng, Chairman and CEO of XPeng Motors, announced at XPeng Tech Day 2026 that the humanoid robot XPeng IRON will enter the hardware mass-production phase in January 2027, with the goal of an official public launch in the second quarter of 2027. IRON is positioned as a general-purpose robot capable of all-weather service. It can schedule itself, work across different roles, and recharge automatically, and it will continuously upgrade through software and hardware OTA to evolve into a true robot employee.

According to the company, IRON can work continuously 24/7 and can autonomously switch between roles such as shopping guide, greeter, internal trainer, and security based on its schedule. In the future, it will also expand to scenarios such as holiday duty, allowing one robot to meet service needs across multiple positions.

To drive large-scale mass production, XPeng is simultaneously advancing robot manufacturing, testing, and application scenario development. Its fully automated complete-robot assembly line is equipped with more than 600 AI holographic quality inspection items and combines more than 1,000 vehicle-grade complete-robot tests with key component validation to improve assembly consistency and long-term operational reliability.

He Xiaopeng said that large-scale mass production is a key part of building a data flywheel for humanoid robots. In the future, XPeng also plans to continuously create application value for customers through Token subscriptions and scenario-based service models.
